notes.title: Club Koala Playtest Invitation, April 18th 10 AM EST!
notes.content:
[b]Exciting News! Join Us for Club Koala's Exclusive Island Building Event and Map Creation event![/b]

Club Koala's playtest will launch on April 18th, 10 AM EST and last until April 28th, 23:59 EST! 
[b]Key Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Launch Date: The Alpha Test journey begins in April 18th 10 AM EST.
[*] Access Points: Available on Steam and our official website.
[*] Focus Areas: Emphasis on game stability and exploring the dynamics of party map gameplay.
[/list]
This Alpha Test is your chance to leave a lasting impact on Club Koala. We're seeking insights and honest feedback on what elements you believe will elevate our game. Your contributions will directly influence the direction of development.
[b]What to Expect:[/b]
[list]
[*] Core Focus: Dive into gameplay mechanics, test server stability, and navigate the user interface.
[*] Objective: Our aim is clear—to perfect the user experience. This global Alpha Test marks the beginning of a journey to refine and define the future of Club Koala.
[*] Exclusive Rewards: Play Testers will receive exclusive special lifetime items. Those items will be carried forward to the official launch of the game. Alongside privileges and special items you will be able to shape the future of Club Koala.
[/list]
[u]As a special thanks and to celebrate this shared excitement,[/u] we're offering exclusive events and rewards! We've decided to give back to our amazing community and all our playtesters and collaborters. A special thanks to everyone for all the love and support you've shown us. Join us on our offcial [url=https://discord.gg/club-koala-992272718219186267]Discord[/url] to participate in exclusive events and shape the future of Club Koala[url=https://discord.gg/club-koala-992272718219186267] Discord[/url]! Top prizes of 7,000USD and much more! 

In this early stage, we're concentrating on fundamental features such as party game maps, intuitive user interfaces, game stability, and overall gameplay. Rest assured, Club Koala is bustling with exciting features in development, and we're eager to share these advancements with you in the coming months.

[b]Your Role in Shaping the Future:[/b]
Club Koala isn't just a game; it's a community-driven project where every feedback and idea contributes to the game's evolution. In the Alpha Test, you're not just testing a game—you're joining a vibrant [url=https://discord.gg/club-koala-992272718219186267]community[/url] in shaping the future!

If you need any support head over to our exclusive[url=https://discord.gg/club-koala-992272718219186267] Discord support channel[/url] for 24/7 support! 

Best Regards,
The Club Koala Community Team
